description: Create Resident, Barangay, and ResidentActivity database models with relationships, and register them in models/index.js. These form the data backbone for the RIMS module. Barangay stores municipal subdivisions, Resident stores resident records with auto-generated IDs (BSD-YYYY-NNNNN), and ResidentActivity tracks audit history for resident records.
steps: Create models/Barangay.js with fields: id (PK), name (unique, string), description (text), createdAt, updatedAt. Table name: 'barangays'.

Create models/Resident.js with fields: id (PK), resident_id (unique, string, auto-generated), first_name, middle_name, last_name, birthdate (date), sex (ENUM: Male/Female), civil_status (ENUM: Single/Married/Widowed/Separated/Annulled), address (text), barangay_id (FK to barangays), contact_number, email, status (ENUM: active/archived, default: active), created_at, updated_at. Table name: 'residents'. Add associations: belongsTo Barangay, hasMany ResidentActivity.

Create models/ResidentActivity.js with fields: id (PK), resident_id (FK to residents), action (ENUM: created/updated/archived/restored), description (text), user_id (FK to users), createdAt. Table name: 'resident_activities'. Add associations: belongsTo Resident, belongsTo User.
Update models/index.js to import all three new models from their respective files.

Add associations to models/index.js: Barangay.hasMany(Resident), Resident.belongsTo(Barangay), Resident.hasMany(ResidentActivity), ResidentActivity.belongsTo(Resident), ResidentActivity.belongsTo(User), User.hasMany(ResidentActivity).
Export the three new models from models/index.js alongside existing exports.
Test database sync: Run 'npm run xian' and observe that new tables create without errors in console output.
acceptance_criteria: models/Barangay.js, models/Resident.js, models/ResidentActivity.js files exist with correct fields and types
models/index.js imports and exports all three new models
Association declarations in models/index.js establish bidirectional relationships correctly
npm run xian starts without database errors; tables barangays, residents, resident_activities created in SmartCivi database
verification: Run 'npm run xian' and check console for 'XianFire running at http://localhost:3000' with no Sequelize errors
Connect to MySQL: 'mysql -u root' then 'USE SmartCivi;' then 'SHOW TABLES;' and confirm barangays, residents, resident_activities tables exist
Verify table structures: 'DESCRIBE residents;' shows resident_id (unique), first_name, sex (ENUM), civil_status (ENUM), status (ENUM), barangay_id (FK), created_at, updated_at
Verify associations by examining models/index.js and confirming no JavaScript errors on import
findings: Resident auto-generation strategy: resident_id will be generated in residentController.js as 'BSD-' + year + '-' + zero-padded sequence. Models define the schema only.
